title: Self-Pay Allowance on Home-Visit Settlements, Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
**Specimen Collection Appointments — self-pay allowance on the settlement of a collected Mobile In-Home Collection Visit.**

The allowance turns on two records: how the order the visit collects is billed, as its record in Laboratory Test Orders shows the billing method (insurance, self-pay or client account), and whether the patient has a live health coverage on file in Insurance Coverage & Claims. A coverage on file counts as live until it is terminated, whatever its verification status: an active coverage, a coverage pending verification and an inactive coverage are all live; a terminated coverage is not.

**Clause.** When the order the visit collects is billed to the patient as self-pay and the patient has no live health coverage on file, the allowance is 10 percent; when the order is billed as self-pay and the patient does have a live coverage on file, it is 5 percent; when the order is billed to insurance or to a client account, there is none.

## Truth table

| Billing method of the order | Live coverage on file | Self-pay allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Self-pay | None (no coverage, or every coverage terminated) | 10 percent |
| Self-pay | At least one (active, pending verification or inactive) | 5 percent |
| Insurance | Any | None |
| Client account | Any | None |

## Cases (hypothetical patients)

- Self-pay order; the only coverage on file is terminated: 10 percent.
- Self-pay order; one coverage on file pending verification: 5 percent.
- Order billed to insurance: none.
